mapper.query:
SELECT 
    transaction_id, 
    candidate_id, 
    joborder_id, 
    process_status, 
    risk_level, 
    cedula, 
    document_type, 
    tusdatos_job_id, 
    tusdatos_report_id AS report_id, 
    report_url, 
    CAST(retry_count AS INT64) AS retry_count
FROM `g4s-shared-tz1.CO_G4S_DATA.Tusdatos_TransactionControl`
WHERE 
    (process_status IN ('PROCESSING', 'PENDING') AND created_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 3 HOUR))
    OR 
    (process_status = 'PARTIAL_WAITING_RETRY' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 HOUR))
